sections.heading: Who Needs Commercial Storm Shelters in North Texas?
sections.html:
Tornadoes and severe weather are a constant threat in North Texas. Facilities with multiple occupants require a robust plan to ensure everyone's safety. Our commercial storm shelters are designed for a variety of public and private entities, providing a designated safe haven during dangerous weather.

We serve:

  • Businesses & Job Sites: Protect employees and valuable assets on your commercial property or construction site.
  • Churches & Places of Worship: Offer a secure gathering point for your congregation during severe weather events.
  • Daycares & Schools: Ensure the safety of children and staff with a reliable, accessible safe room.
  • Subdivision & Community Centers: Provide a designated tornado shelter for residents in multi-family housing or planned communities.

Investing in a commercial safe room demonstrates a commitment to the well-being of your people and property.

sections.heading: Meeting FEMA P-361 & ICC-500 Standards
sections.html:
When it comes to commercial and community storm shelters, adherence to federal and industry standards is paramount. Texoma Storm Shelters installs units that comply with both FEMA P-361 and ICC-500 guidelines. These standards outline the design and construction criteria for safe rooms capable of providing near-absolute protection from tornadoes and high winds.

FEMA P-361, 'Safe Rooms for Tornadoes and Hurricanes: Guidance for Community and Residential Safe Rooms,' provides detailed specifications for constructing shelters that can withstand extreme forces. Similarly, ICC-500, 'Standard for the Design and Construction of Storm Shelters,' is the benchmark for performance requirements for storm shelters. Our commitment to these standards ensures your commercial safe room offers the highest level of protection available.

We understand the technical requirements and ensure every installation meets these critical benchmarks for life safety.

sections.heading: Designing & Installing Your Community Safe Room
sections.html:
The process of adding a commercial or community safe room begins with a thorough assessment of your needs. We consider factors like your facility's occupancy, available space, and specific operational requirements. Our team works with you to determine the ideal size and type of shelter, whether it's an above-ground safe room or a custom solution.

Once the design is finalized, our licensed and insured installers handle the entire project. We manage site preparation, foundation work, and the precise construction and anchoring of your shelter. Our goal is to provide a seamless installation that minimizes disruption to your operations while ensuring the safe room is ready to protect when needed.

We can help you navigate options for financing and potential rebate programs, making the investment in safety more accessible. Contact us for a free written estimate.

faq.q: How much do commercial storm shelters cost in North Texas?
faq.a: Commercial storm shelters in North Texas typically range from $15,000 for smaller units designed for about 10-15 people, to over $75,000 for larger, custom-built community safe rooms accommodating 100+ occupants. The final cost depends on capacity, features, and installation complexity. We provide free written estimates for precise pricing.

faq.q: What is FEMA P-361 compliance for commercial safe rooms?
faq.a: FEMA P-361 is a federal guideline that outlines the design and construction criteria for community and residential safe rooms, ensuring they provide near-absolute protection from tornadoes and hurricanes. For commercial applications, meeting FEMA P-361 means the shelter is engineered to withstand extreme wind speeds and debris impact, protecting occupants during severe weather events. Our shelters meet these stringent standards.

faq.q: What types of facilities benefit most from commercial storm shelters?
faq.a: Any facility with a significant number of occupants can benefit from a commercial storm shelter. This includes businesses, industrial job sites, churches, daycares, schools, and community centers within subdivisions. These shelters provide a designated, safe location for employees, congregations, students, and residents to gather during a tornado or severe storm warning.

faq.q: How long does it take to install a commercial storm shelter?
faq.a: The installation timeline for a commercial storm shelter varies based on its size, complexity, and site preparation required. Smaller units might be installed within a few days, while larger, custom-built community safe rooms could take several weeks. We provide a detailed project schedule with your free written estimate, outlining all stages from planning to completion.

faq.q: What capacity do your commercial storm shelters offer?
faq.a: Our commercial safe rooms can be designed to protect anywhere from 10 to over 100 people, depending on your specific needs and the size of the structure. We conduct a thorough assessment to determine the appropriate capacity for your business, church, daycare, or community, ensuring everyone has adequate space and protection during a severe weather event.
